newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic to increase US capacity.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic to increase US capacity.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc on Friday said it expects to increase its U.S. production capacity of rapid tests to between 3 million and 6 million tests per year.

In a statement the company said it also expects to submit its rapid tests for HIV and H. pylori, a bacteria linked to peptic ulcers and gastric cancers, for approval in several countries, including the United States this year.
The company develops and manufacturs rapid diagnostic tests for infectious diseases and other conditions.
